# POST /api/v1/user/avatar

Update the authenticated user's avatar with a base64-encoded image

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer|basic (required) · **ID:** `ep-128`

## Request

**Headers:** `Authorization`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `UpdateUserAvatarOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `image` | string | True | binding:Required, must be valid base64-encoded image data |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — Invalid base64 encoding
- **500** — Image processing or storage failure

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.UpdateAvatar | controller | Get form from request body; Decode base64 image; Call user_service.UploadAvatar |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | user_service.UploadAvatar | service | Process avatar image (crop/resize); Begin transaction; Set UseCustomAvatar=true; Generate avatar hash; Update user columns; Save to storage |
| 3 | [modules](../modules/modules.md) | avatar.ProcessAvatarImage | utility | Decode image config (type/dimensions); Validate image type (png/jpeg/gif/webp); Check max width/height; If small enough, return original; Crop to square; Resize to DefaultAvatarSize * RenderedSizeFactor; Encode as PNG |
| 4 | [modules](../modules/modules.md) | storage.SaveFrom(storage.Avatars, ...) | utility ⚡ | Save processed image to configured avatar storage (local/minio/azure) |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Avatar image must be valid base64 and a supported image type (png/jpeg/gif/webp) within size limits | validation | imgType not in [png, jpeg, gif, webp] OR width > MaxWidth OR height > MaxHeight |
| Avatar upload is transactional: DB update and storage write happen in same transaction | business_logic | Always |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Invalid base64 in image field | 400 | error message | False |
| Unsupported type or oversized image | 500 | internal error | False |
| Failed to save avatar to storage | 500 | internal error | True |

### Error Paths

- **Invalid base64 encoding** → user.UpdateAvatar → 400
- **Image processing failure (unsupported type, too large)** → user_service.UploadAvatar → 500
- **Storage write failure** → user_service.UploadAvatar → 500
- **DB update failure** → user_service.UploadAvatar → 500

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** medium

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| non_atomic | ✅ configured | low | DB update and storage write are in same transaction via db.WithTx, but storage write failure after DB commit could leave inconsistent state |
| timeout | ❌ missing | medium | No timeout on storage write operation for remote storage backends |
